user.title: Choose the camera type
user.description: Each type only asks for what it needs.

imou.title: Imou / Dahua camera
imou.description: The speaker talks over the camera's TCP port 37777. Password: device password or the safety code on the label. Fill the mic URL only for the Assist satellite, e.g. http://HOST:1984/api/stream.mp4?src=cam-sub&video=none&audio=all

ezviz.title: EZVIZ camera
ezviz.description: The speaker talks over the RTSP audio backchannel (port 554, user admin — filled in). The password is the VERIFICATION CODE: 6 capital letters on the label under the camera. Fill the mic URL only for the Assist satellite, e.g. http://HOST:1984/api/stream.mp4?src=cam-sub&video=none&audio=all

data.name: Name
data.password: Verification code (6 capital letters on the label)

onvif.title: Hikvision / ONVIF camera
onvif.description: The speaker talks over the RTSP/ONVIF audio backchannel. Hikvision main stream: /Streaming/Channels/101. Fill the mic URL only for the Assist satellite.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure camera
reconfigure.description: The intercom key is kept — the exec: line already in go2rtc.yaml keeps working. Leave the password empty to keep the current one.

error.invalid_auth: The camera refused the login (it locks the session after a few wrong passwords — check before retrying).
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the camera's talk port.
error.invalid_mic_url: Mic URL must start with rtsp://, http:// or https://
error.no_backchannel: The camera speaks RTSP but this stream has no audio backchannel (no speaker, or wrong stream path).

get_intercom_source.name: go2rtc source for intercom
get_intercom_source.description: Returns the exec: line to append to the camera stream in go2rtc.yaml so the WebRTC Camera card can talk through the camera speaker.

ha_url.name: HA address for go2rtc
ha_url.description: Leave empty when go2rtc shares HA's network (go2rtc add-on). go2rtc on another machine/VM or inside Frigate: HA's LAN address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123.
